company_profile: A vacation rental technology company whose search ranking and recommendation systems decide which holiday homes guests discover first.
title: Senior Data Scientist - Rankings & Recommendations
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years taking ML models from conception to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds ranking and recommendation work with rerankers, fine-tuned cross-encoders and SBERT embeddings, and XGBoost and LightGBM on large tabular data, using Python, SQL, Airflow and MLflow. Monitors models in production and works closely with product and engineering stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Implemented a reranker for an existing recommendation system
experience_edits.new: Implemented a reranker for an existing recommendation system serving individual and child plan recommendations, improving the ranking of renewal suggestions and increasing conversion by 2%.

experience_edits.original: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs
experience_edits.new: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder ranking model on positive and negative pairs to re-rank dense retrieval over AARP survey data, improving retrieval accuracy.

experience_edits.original: Developed an XGBoost propensity model predicting personal-loan applications
experience_edits.new: Built an XGBoost propensity model on tabular customer data predicting personal-loan applications within 7 days of contact, enabling targeted outreach and customer prioritization.

experience_edits.new: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction model with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow for real-time scoring, using GPT-3.5 for root-cause analysis and remediation recommendations per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.

project.name: Cold-Start Listing Ranker
bullets: Built a two-stage ranking system for a travel marketplace, blending LightGBM learning-to-rank on behavioural signals with SBERT listing embeddings so new listings ranked well before any interactions.
Evaluated with NDCG on offline replays and a simulated A/B test, then scheduled retraining in Airflow and tracked drift and online/offline agreement in MLflow.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in Rankings & Recommendations at Holidu. As a data scientist I have built rerankers and recommendation models and taken them to production, alongside gradient boosting on tabular data. The thread through my work is deciding what someone should see first, and checking that the choice helped.

Holidu's search has to balance relevance, conversion and business value while a large share of homes are new and most visitors are anonymous. Those cold-start and personalisation problems are exactly the ones I want to work on. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Munich together and settle there long term.

I would bring ranking experience and production care. At Optum I added a reranker to a plan recommendation system that increased conversion by 2%. More recently I fine-tuned a cross-encoder to re-rank dense retrieval, and at Viavi I ran a LightGBM prediction system with MLflow that cut downtime by 67%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to let real usage decide what stays. I would be glad to talk about where I could help Search Intelligence next.
